lines.zh: 我四条黏土腿一步一步挪
lines.en: My four clay legs shift step by step

lines.zh: 沙子从我的关节缝里漏出来
lines.en: Sand leaks from my joints
My mane is a row of dry straw

lines.zh: 我走起来有细碎的响声
lines.en: I make a soft gritty sound as I walk

lines.zh: 我的蹄子印在沙上是圆的
lines.en: My prints in the sand come out round
I head toward the camp
I stop and shake my back

lines.zh: 我背上还有没捏开的纹
lines.en: My flank still shows unshaped seams
I walk step by step, very properly

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的缓坡上下来
lines.en: I come down a gentle dune

lines.zh: 我的蹄印一落地就被沙填。
lines.en: Sand fills my hoofprints as soon as I make them.

lines.zh: 我走上一条被踩实的路
lines.en: I take a trodden path
My shadow is a thin sheet

lines.zh: 我在主人的马位边站住
lines.en: I stop at my master's place
I stand and my body dries out
Sand slides down my back
I don't truly breathe
I dip my sandy head

lines.zh: 我的耳朵是两片小泥块
lines.en: My ears are two little clay slabs
I wait for someone to mount

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛吹得散开
lines.en: Wind scatters my mane

lines.zh: 风从我的眼窝里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes through my eye sockets.
Plenty of sun here

lines.zh: 我站着不动，几乎像雕塑
lines.en: I stand so still I'm almost sculpture
My joints have fine cracks
I listen to the camp

lines.zh: 沙子从我身上落到地上
lines.en: Sand falls from me to the ground
My hoofprints crumble as I make them.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在风里掉了一点
lines.en: A little of my ear blows away

lines.zh: 我用前蹄把散落的沙拨回来
lines.en: I sweep the spilled sand back with a forehoof
I turn and look at you

lines.zh: 你的手掌比我的沙脖子暖。
lines.en: Your palm is warmer than my sandy neck.
Are you the new master
My reins are pressed from fine sand

lines.zh: 你摸我的脖子，沙会沾手
lines.en: Touch my neck and sand will cling
I can't whinny; I only rasp
If you're riding, get up

lines.zh: 你站得离我的蹄子远点
lines.en: Keep clear of my hooves

lines.zh: 你伸手，我的脖子掉下一点沙。
lines.en: You reach out; a little sand falls from my neck.
I know that gesture

lines.zh: 我抬起一只前蹄，又放下
lines.en: I lift a forehoof and set it down
As you come near, I smell earth
I cock my clay head at you

lines.zh: 我等你把手放到缰绳上
lines.en: I wait for your hand on the reins
A lump of sand falls off me
I rock and steady

lines.zh: 我少了一条腿的沙，站不稳。
lines.en: Sand is missing from one leg; I can't stand straight.
Sand pours from the gap
I back off two hoofprints
Not a grain of me makes a sound
I drop my head low
I turn, dragging sand
A new crack runs across me
I'm still standing there
You're carrying water
Water would soften my legs
Just set the water down
I can smell that damp
Don't splash it on me
I come closer only to smell
I can't drink it
The water's too near me
Move it back a bit
I've backed off; I'll stand here
You hit me and sand shakes loose
I rock, and my hooves hold
Your shoulder knocks a piece off

lines.zh: 我退了两步，沙撒了一路
lines.en: I back two steps, shedding sand
You squeeze past my back

lines.zh: 我的干草尾巴扫过你的腿
lines.en: My straw tail sweeps your leg
We both come to a stop
I lower my head and let you pass
Sand gathers at my feet

lines.zh: 我从地上把掉的补回来
lines.en: I take up the fallen sand again
There's another in the camp
It's sand, and so am I

lines.zh: 两匹沙马挤在同一片阴影。
lines.en: Two sand horses crowd into one patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我们的鬃毛都被风吹歪
lines.en: The wind bends both our manes
It's half a head lower than me
Two clay heads lean together
Sand falls between us
We wait for the master together
We make not even a rustle of sand

lines.zh: 两匹马拴在同一根柱上
lines.en: Two horses on one post

lines.zh: 我低头用嘴把它钳起来
lines.en: I lower my head and pinch it up
It has no taste at all
Sand sticks to my mouth
I set it at the master's feet
It's too smooth to grip
I push it with a hoof
This isn't mine
I stand and watch it a while
Sand has half buried it
I leave it be
Someone's near the post
I turn my sand neck to look

lines.zh: 沙被刨开，露出底下的硬土。
lines.en: I scrape the sand away, exposing hard earth.
This ground is our camp's

lines.zh: 我的沙身挡住马厩的光。
lines.en: My sandy bulk blocks the stable's light.
Sand runs under my hooves
I'll block this path

lines.zh: 我的沙鬃一根根竖起来。
lines.en: My sand mane rises strand by strand.
I lower my head to charge
My body is hard as brick

lines.zh: 我前蹄在地上敲了两下
lines.en: I strike the ground twice

lines.zh: 沙子从我的鬃毛里抖出来
lines.en: Sand shakes out of my mane
I shift toward it inch by inch
My head stays low
You step back and I stop
Sand parts under my hooves
I stand before the post

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，什么也喊不出
lines.en: My mouth opens on nothing
You circle and I turn

lines.zh: 我横过来，堵住马厩的门。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block the stable door.

lines.zh: 我的沙子眼睛一直盯着你
lines.en: My sand eyes stay on you
You don't pass here
I turn broadside in the gateway
You go left and I shift left
I'm not quick, but I'll hold
I butt you with my head
Sand comes with the blow
I rear and strike
You pull back covered in sand

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，自己掉了一块
lines.en: I hit your leg and lose a piece myself
That one lands in the sand

lines.zh: 沙扬起来，挡住了你的眼睛
lines.en: Sand rises into your eyes
I butt forward again
You cave my shoulder in

lines.zh: 沙做的马腿，晃两下站住。
lines.en: Sand-made legs wobble, then hold.
A horse rises out of the sand

lines.zh: 沙子从我的轮廓里落下来
lines.en: Sand falls off my outline
My mane takes shape first

lines.zh: 马位旁边多了一个影子
lines.en: A new shadow stands by the post

lines.zh: 我站直了，抖掉多余的沙
lines.en: I straighten and shake off the excess
I walk step by step into camp
The sun stretches my shadow
Someone shaped me
I raise my head for a rider

lines.zh: 我的蹄子第一次落在土上
lines.en: My hooves touch earth for the first time

lines.zh: 沙丘那边有一匹马站起来了
lines.en: A horse rises on the dune
The wind combs my mane
I shake the loose sand off
My shadow is faint on the sand
I take my place at the camp's edge
I raise my head and wait for a word

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的沙子变了色
lines.en: Fire bakes my sand and it changes color
I fall and part of me scatters
Water soaks me and my legs soften
The blast strips a layer off me
An arrow lodges in my flank

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的黏土发硬
lines.en: That force bakes my clay hard

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可我也没力气了
lines.en: I don't eat, but my strength is gone

lines.zh: 雷打进我身体，沙都跳起来
lines.en: Lightning enters me and the sand leaps

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我散成一把沙
lines.en: No ground below; I scatter into sand
